about.status.description.defaultMessage: 營運者會在狀態頁面公告這個伺服器的故障與維護。即使這個伺服器沒有回應，狀態頁面仍可開啟。
about.status.description.description: Paragraph in the server status section of the server's information page: what the status page is for.

about.status.link.description: Link to the server's status page, on another site, on the server's information page. The link leaves the app.

about.description.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page with the server's description.

about.domains.kind.limit.defaultMessage: 已限制：它的貼文不會出現在公開時間軸

about.domains.loading.defaultMessage: 正在載入受審核的伺服器

about.domains.retry.description: Button that tries again to load the list of moderated servers after a failure.

about.domains.sign_in.description: Link after the note that only signed-in users can see the list of moderated servers; it opens the sign-in screen.

about.domains.signed_in_only.defaultMessage: 只有已登入的使用者可以查看這份列表。

about.domains.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page that lists the other servers whose federation this server limits or suspends.

about.crawlers.search.defaultMessage: {setting, select, allow {搜尋引擎可以為允許索引的帳號的個人檔案與公開貼文建立索引。} other {這個伺服器要求搜尋引擎不要為它的任何頁面建立索引。}}
about.crawlers.search.description: What the server states to search engines, by the server setting search_indexing (allow or deny).

about.crawlers.ai.defaultMessage: {setting, select, allow {這個伺服器不對 AI 設任何保留：AI 可以使用它的頁面並以其訓練，但選擇退出的帳號的頁面除外。} deny_training {這個伺服器保留其頁面，不供訓練 AI 模型。AI 搜尋與助理仍可使用這些頁面，但選擇退出的帳號的頁面除外。} other {這個伺服器保留其頁面，不供訓練 AI 模型，也不供 AI 搜尋、助理與代理使用。}}
about.crawlers.ai.description: What the server states to AI crawlers, by the server setting ai_usage (allow, deny_training, or deny).

about.crawlers.details.defaultMessage: 伺服器如何表明，以及在法律上的意義
about.crawlers.details.description: Summary of the folded details under the server's statements to search engines and AI: how it states them, the accounts' own choices, and their legal meaning.

about.crawlers.how.defaultMessage: 伺服器透過 robots.txt（附上已知 AI 爬蟲的列表）、頁面的 robots meta 標籤與 X-Robots-Tag、Content-Usage、tdm-reservation 標頭，以及 /.well-known/tdmrep.json 表明這些設定。這些只是請求：知名爬蟲表示會遵守其中一部分，但技術上無法阻止不遵守的爬蟲。
about.crawlers.how.description: How the server states its search and AI settings: the machine-readable means it uses.

about.crawlers.accounts.defaultMessage: 每個帳號也可以讓自己在這個伺服器上的頁面不被搜尋引擎收錄，或拒絕 AI。帳號無法允許伺服器拒絕的事項。媒體檔案以及其他伺服器上的貼文副本不會帶有帳號的選擇。
about.crawlers.accounts.description: That each account can narrow the server's statement for its own pages, but never widen it.

about.crawlers.legal.defaultMessage: 這類聲明在法律上的意義因國家而異，許多營運者會自願遵守這類聲明。本文不構成法律建議。
about.crawlers.legal.description: The legal note under the server's AI statement. Must not promise a legal effect.

about.link_card_crawler.title.description: Heading (h1) of the page that tells the operators of other websites about the crawler that fetches the links in posts. {instance} is the server's name.

about.link_card_crawler.intro.defaultMessage: 當這個伺服器上的貼文連結到網頁時，伺服器會擷取該頁面，以顯示含有標題、說明與圖片的卡片。本頁說明這些請求的內容，以及網站營運者如何拒絕。
about.link_card_crawler.intro.description: Opening paragraph of the page about the link card crawler.

about.link_card_crawler.state.obeys.defaultMessage: 在這個伺服器上，爬蟲已開啟，並會遵守 robots.txt。
about.link_card_crawler.state.obeys.description: What the crawler does on this server, in its usual settings: at the top of the page about the crawler.

about.link_card_crawler.state.ignores.defaultMessage: 在這個伺服器上，爬蟲已開啟，且依營運者的選擇不讀取 robots.txt。網站無法在這裡用 robots.txt 拒絕它。頁面的指令仍然有效，營運者也可以停止擷取某個網域。
about.link_card_crawler.state.ignores.description: What the crawler does on a server whose setting link_cards_ignore_robots_txt is on: at the top of the page about the crawler.

about.link_card_crawler.state.off.defaultMessage: 在這個伺服器上，連結卡片已關閉，因此爬蟲目前不會擷取任何內容。本頁其餘部分說明開啟時它會做什麼。
about.link_card_crawler.state.off.description: What the crawler does on a server whose setting link_cards is off: at the top of the page about the crawler.

about.link_card_crawler.loading.defaultMessage: 正在載入這個伺服器的設定
about.link_card_crawler.loading.description: Label of the spinner while the page about the crawler loads the settings of the server.

about.link_card_crawler.failed.defaultMessage: 無法載入爬蟲在這個伺服器上的行為
about.link_card_crawler.failed.description: Heading of the error in place of the page about the crawler when the settings of the server cannot be read.

about.link_card_crawler.retry.description: Button that loads the settings of the server again after a failure, on the page about the crawler.

about.link_card_crawler.identity.title.description: Heading of the section with the User-Agent of the link card crawler.

about.link_card_crawler.identity.user_ag.defaultMessage: 它的請求帶有這個 User-Agent：
about.link_card_crawler.identity.user_ag.description: Sentence before the User-Agent of the crawler, shown as code.

about.link_card_crawler.identity.token.defaultMessage: 其中的位址就是這個伺服器。在 robots.txt 與頁面的指令中，這個爬蟲的名稱是 my-linkcard。
about.link_card_crawler.identity.token.description: Explains the User-Agent of the crawler and the name it goes by. my-linkcard is a literal name: do not translate it.

about.link_card_crawler.identity.others.defaultMessage: 這個伺服器還會以 my/ 的名稱發出其他請求，例如聯邦，本頁不涵蓋這些請求。其中有兩種可能在卡片之後發生：為了向讀者顯示，它可能會以 my/ 再次擷取卡片的圖片，也會查詢頁面所指定的 fediverse:creator 帳號。
about.link_card_crawler.identity.others.description: Other requests of the server that a site operator can see, under the server's general User-Agent. my/ and fediverse:creator are literal: do not translate them.

about.link_card_crawler.trigger.title.description: Heading of the section that says what makes the crawler fetch a URL.

about.link_card_crawler.trigger.post.defaultMessage: 連結到該 URL 的貼文。無論貼文的可見範圍為何，伺服器都會用貼文內文的第一個連結建立卡片，若沒有該頁面的近期卡片就會擷取頁面。
about.link_card_crawler.trigger.post.description: What makes the crawler fetch a URL.

about.link_card_crawler.trigger.remote.defaultMessage: 這也包括從其他伺服器送來的貼文，而不只是在這裡撰寫的貼文，因此收到請求並不代表這裡有人讀過你的頁面。
about.link_card_crawler.trigger.remote.description: That posts federated from other servers cause fetches too.

about.link_card_crawler.fetches.title.description: Heading of the section that lists what the crawler requests from a website.

about.link_card_crawler.fetches.page.defaultMessage: 頁面本身。它只讀取頁面的 head，最多跟隨 5 次重新導向，且不執行頁面中的任何內容。
about.link_card_crawler.fetches.page.description: What the crawler fetches: the linked page.

about.link_card_crawler.fetches.image.defaultMessage: 一張圖片，也就是頁面 head 所指定的那張。
about.link_card_crawler.fetches.image.description: What the crawler fetches: the page's image.

about.link_card_crawler.fetches.robots.defaultMessage: 在請求頁面與圖片之前，先擷取其來源的 robots.txt。
about.link_card_crawler.fetches.robots.description: What the crawler fetches: robots.txt. Shown only while the server reads it.

about.link_card_crawler.fetches.nothing_.defaultMessage: 它不會跟隨任何連結，因此不會爬取你網站的其他部分。
about.link_card_crawler.fetches.nothing_.description: That the crawler does not crawl a whole website.

about.link_card_crawler.sends.title.description: Heading of the section that says what the crawler's requests carry.

about.link_card_crawler.sends.headers.defaultMessage: 上述的 User-Agent、它接受的內容類型，以及擷取頁面時在 Accept-Language 中帶上這個伺服器的預設語言。

about.link_card_crawler.sends.not.defaultMessage: 它不會傳送 Cookie 或 Referer，也不會透露是哪個帳號或哪則貼文連結了該頁面。
about.link_card_crawler.sends.not.description: What the crawler's requests do not carry.

about.link_card_crawler.frequency.title.description: Heading of the section that says how often the crawler requests a URL.

about.link_card_crawler.frequency.once.defaultMessage: 每個 URL 只擷取一次，連結到它的貼文會共用同一張卡片。只有在上次擷取已過 14 天以上時，貼文才會再次擷取；伺服器不會自行重新檢查它的卡片。
about.link_card_crawler.frequency.once.description: How often the crawler requests a page.

about.link_card_crawler.frequency.failur.defaultMessage: 擷取失敗的 URL 在 24 小時內不會再次請求。

about.link_card_crawler.frequency.host.defaultMessage: 它對同一主機一次只發出一個請求，請求之間至少間隔一秒。只有請求的重新導向及所需的 robots.txt 會隨之一起發出。
about.link_card_crawler.frequency.host.description: The limit of the crawler per host.

about.link_card_crawler.frequency.thrott.defaultMessage: 當主機回應 429 或 503 時，爬蟲會在 Retry-After 指定的時間內（最多一小時）不向它請求任何內容；若沒有 Retry-After 則暫停一分鐘。同一 URL 收到 5 次這類回應後，就會視為擷取失敗。
about.link_card_crawler.frequency.thrott.description: That the crawler stops for a host that asks it to. 429, 503 and Retry-After are literal.

about.link_card_crawler.frequency.robots.defaultMessage: 每個來源（scheme、主機與連接埠）的 robots.txt 大約每天讀取一次。無法讀取時（429、5xx 或網路故障），爬蟲不會從該來源擷取任何內容，並在一小時後重試。
about.link_card_crawler.frequency.robots.description: How often the crawler reads robots.txt. Shown only while the server reads it.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.title.description: Heading of the section that says how a website refuses the crawler.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.robots.t.description: Heading (h3) of the part about refusing the crawler in robots.txt. robots.txt is literal.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.robots.i.defaultMessage: 若要拒絕對你網站的所有擷取，請在 robots.txt 中加入以下內容：
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.robots.i.description: Sentence before the robots.txt example that refuses the crawler.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.robots.s.defaultMessage: 若沒有該名稱的群組，爬蟲會遵循 * 的群組。它依 RFC 9309 讀取 Allow、Disallow、* 與 $，因此你也可以只拒絕部分路徑。
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.robots.s.description: How the crawler reads robots.txt. Allow, Disallow, *, $ and RFC 9309 are literal.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.robots.t.defaultMessage: 爬蟲會在一天內遵守新的規則。已有的卡片會在貼文再次擷取其 URL 時移除；若你向營運者提出要求，則會更早移除。
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.robots.t.description: When a change of robots.txt takes effect.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.robots.i.defaultMessage: 這個伺服器不讀取 robots.txt，因此這條規則在這裡無效。它在遵守 robots.txt 的伺服器上有效。
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.robots.i.description: Under the robots.txt part, on a server whose setting link_cards_ignore_robots_txt is on.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.defaultMessage: 限制卡片內容：頁面的指令
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.description: Heading (h3) of the part about the page directives that change a card.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.defaultMessage: 頁面可以讓卡片不顯示其說明或圖片。爬蟲仍會請求頁面，因為它要從頁面得知這些指令。無論這個伺服器對 robots.txt 的設定為何，這些指令都有效：

Visually hidden name of the table of page directives.
Column header: what the directive does to the card.
What the directives nosnippet and max-snippet:0 do to a card.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.defaultMessage: 不顯示圖片，也不請求圖片。
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.description: What the directives noimageindex and max-image-preview:none do to a card.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.defaultMessage: 沒有變化。這些指令要求不出現在搜尋結果中，而卡片並非搜尋結果：卡片只會因為有人在貼文中放了連結而出現，而許多不出現在搜尋結果中的頁面本來就是要被分享的。若要拒絕，請使用 robots.txt。
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.description: What the directives noindex and none do to a card, with the reason in plain words.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.defaultMessage: 沒有變化。這些指令要求不出現在搜尋結果中，而卡片並非搜尋結果：卡片只會因為有人在貼文中放了連結而出現，而許多不出現在搜尋結果中的頁面本來就是要被分享的。若要在這個伺服器上拒絕，請聯絡營運者。
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.description: What the directives noindex and none do to a card, on a server that does not read robots.txt.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.defaultMessage: 無論使用哪個指令，標題、網站名稱與作者都會保留。
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.description: What no page directive removes from a card.

about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.defaultMessage: 請將指令寫在頁面 head 中名為 robots 或 my-linkcard 的 meta 標籤，或寫在 X-Robots-Tag 標頭中：
about.link_card_crawler.opt_out.directiv.description: Sentence before the examples of where a directive goes. robots, my-linkcard and X-Robots-Tag are literal.

about.link_card_crawler.contact.title.defaultMessage: 聯絡這個伺服器的營運者
about.link_card_crawler.contact.title.description: Heading of the section with how to reach the operators of the server that runs the crawler.

about.link_card_crawler.contact.intro.defaultMessage: 營運者可以針對某個網域及其子網域停止爬蟲，或只停止擷取圖片。這會立即生效，也適用於伺服器已有的卡片，因此若你需要停止擷取或移除卡片，請聯絡他們。
about.link_card_crawler.contact.intro.description: That the operators of the server can stop the crawler per domain, and that a site operator can ask them.

about.link_card_crawler.contact.none.defaultMessage: 這個伺服器沒有公開聯絡方式。
about.link_card_crawler.contact.none.description: In place of the contact details when the server has none.

about.link_card_crawler.contact.about.defaultMessage: 進一步了解這個伺服器
about.link_card_crawler.contact.about.description: Link from the page about the crawler to the server's information page.

about.crawlers.link_cards.defaultMessage: 伺服器也會以爬蟲 my-linkcard 的身分，擷取貼文所連結的頁面，以顯示其卡片。
about.crawlers.link_cards.description: In the section of the server's information page about crawlers: that the server itself runs a crawler too, for link cards. my-linkcard is a literal name.

about.crawlers.link_cards_link.defaultMessage: 該爬蟲做什麼，以及網站如何拒絕它
about.crawlers.link_cards_link.description: Link to the page about the server's own crawler (/about/crawler) from the server's information page.

about.costs.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page about what running the server costs, shown when the server publishes its costs.

about.costs.description.defaultMessage: {visibility, select, breakdown {這個伺服器按週、月、年公開營運成本，並依供應商與類別列出明細。項目名稱、備註與個別付款不會公開。} other {這個伺服器按週、月、年公開營運成本的總額。用途、項目名稱與個別付款不會公開。}}
about.costs.description.description: What the server publishes of its running costs, by the server setting finance_visibility (totals or breakdown).

about.income.description.defaultMessage: {visibility, select, plans {這個伺服器按週、月、年公開來自支持者的收入（已扣除付款服務商的手續費與退款），以及各方案目前的會員人數。誰付款、各付了多少不會公開。} other {這個伺服器按週、月、年公開來自支持者的收入總額（已扣除付款服務商的手續費與退款）。誰付款、各付了多少不會公開。}}
about.income.description.description: What the server publishes of its income from the supporter plans, by the server setting income_visibility (totals or plans).

about.income.balance.defaultMessage: 它也會公開收支餘額：收入減去成本。
about.income.balance.description: Note on the server's information page that the balance (income less costs) is published, shown when both the costs and the income are published.

about.costs.link.defaultMessage: {shown, select, both {查看營運成本與收入} income {查看收入} other {查看營運成本}}
about.costs.link.description: Link from the server's information page to the page of the server's running costs and income, by what the server publishes: both, the income only, or the costs only.

about.commerce.title.description: Heading of the section of the information page that links to the server's page of the commerce disclosures of its supporter plans (ADR-0072 §13).

about.commerce.link.description: Link from the information page to the server's page of the commerce disclosures of its supporter plans.

about.external_review.inbound_follow.defaultMessage: 來自其他伺服器的追蹤：誰追蹤了誰。
about.external_review.inbound_follow.description: What the external review of follows covers and what is sent to it.

about.external_review.inbound_status.defaultMessage: {unfollowedDirect, select, true {這個伺服器接收的其他伺服器貼文，包括僅限追蹤者與僅限被提及者的貼文：其內文、發送者，以及這裡是否有人追蹤該發送者。} other {這個伺服器接收的其他伺服器貼文，包括僅限追蹤者的貼文：其內文、發送者，以及這裡是否有人追蹤該發送者。僅限被提及者的貼文只有在這裡有人追蹤該發送者時才會送出。}}
about.external_review.inbound_status.description: What the external review of posts from other servers covers and what is sent to it. {unfollowedDirect} is true when posts for mentioned people are sent also from senders no one on this server follows.

about.external_review.intro.defaultMessage: 這個伺服器在接受下列內容之前，會請外部服務審查。審查只能阻止或標記它所審查的內容，而對帳號採取任何處置都由人來決定。
about.external_review.intro.description: Introduction of the section of the information page about the external review.
